contea di ritrovamento: Wiltshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ D N IVL CRISPVS AVG T

A contemporary copy of a nummus of Crispus dating to AD 321 - 323 (Reece period 16). BEATA TRA-NQVILLITAS (globe on altar inscribed VOT/IS/XX) reverse. Mint of Lyons (reverse); Mint of Trier (obverse). The obverse legend D N IVL CRISPVS AVG T cannot be correct because Crispus was only ever a Caesar.
